build_checks.pass_condition: Final Meizu DTS builds without unresolved includes, duplicate nodes or invalid I2C address conflicts.
Final DTS contains expected addresses: I2C0 0x5d ft5x0x and 0x3e tps65132 if confirmed; I2C1 0x18 BMA253, 0x53 ltr578, 0x0c ST480, 0x6a bq24157 and 0x63 AW3643; I2C3 0x6b mt6311; I2C4 0x28 mt6605.
Only verified target LCM is selected in final defconfig and registered in mt65xx_lcm_list.h; donor Huawei panel selections are absent from final target config.
Bias control is either implemented by the verified target LCM driver or by a verified driver path; suspend/resume and voltage sequencing match stock evidence.
ft5x0x object is built according to policy and DTS supplies stock reset, IRQ, regulator and pinctrl data.
BMA253 and ST480 are enabled with stock orientation; ltr578 is blocked until exact driver or verified-compatible implementation is present.
MT6755 image sensor list contains verified imx278 and exact/verified ov8856jsl entries; headers define matching IDs and all camera objects link.
AW3643 exact implementation is registered; AW3644 reference is not masquerading as AW3643 unless register-level compatibility is proven.
bq24157 charger, mt6311 PMIC path and battery profile compile with Meizu stock charge limits, thermistor data and safe current tables.
MT6605 driver builds and final DTS contains stock I2C4, IRQ, VEN/RST and pinctrl wiring.
Sunwave driver builds only after bus type, reset, IRQ, power and pinctrl are confirmed from stock evidence.
Combo chip, firmware names, WMT configuration, GPIOs and init service expectations are verified before final build promotion.
Audio card, codec/amp, headset detection, mic bias, mixer paths and userspace policy are verified before final build promotion.
Boot log shows no panel ID mismatch, no I2C probe NACK for required devices, no charger safety fault, no camera probe failure, and no unresolved module or symbol errors.

risks.impact: Blank display, unstable suspend/resume, or panel/bias hardware stress.
risks.mitigation: Do not enable donor LCM. Require exact ili9881p_hd_dsi_txd evidence, panel ID, timing and TPS65132 sequence validation.

risks.impact: Subtle pinctrl, clock, regulator, memory map or PMIC failures.
risks.mitigation: Base all board data on stock Meizu DTB/LK/runtime logs, not Huawei project defaults.

risks.impact: ALS/PS probe failure or incorrect lux/proximity readings.
risks.mitigation: Require exact ltr578 driver or verified chip-ID-compatible code path.

risks.impact: Camera probe failure, wrong OTP calibration, bad image quality, or power sequence hang.
risks.mitigation: Validate SENSOR_ID, OTP, module name, lens data, regulators and MIPI lanes.

risks.impact: Incorrect flash current, LED overcurrent, thermal risk or camera flash failure.
risks.mitigation: Use exact AW3643 implementation and stock current/timeout tables.

risks.impact: Battery safety and thermal behavior risk.
risks.mitigation: Verify bq24157, thermistor, JEITA and current limits from Meizu stock files.

risks.impact: Incorrect DTS node can block probe or conflict with another peripheral.
risks.mitigation: Extract stock bus, chip select/address, GPIOs and regulator data before binding.

risks.impact: Build may boot but lack core connectivity or sound.
risks.mitigation: Run separate Wi-Fi and audio audits before final board sign-off.

script_plan.name: stock_evidence_matrix
script_plan.purpose: Collect stock DTB/LK/dmesg/proc evidence and map each claimed component to bus, address, GPIOs, regulators and compatible names.

script_plan.name: source_inventory_validator
script_plan.purpose: For each component alias, classify local-tree evidence as exact, variant, reference-only or absent across driver source, Kconfig, Makefile, DTS and defconfig.

script_plan.name: registration_consistency_validator
script_plan.purpose: Validate LCM table, image sensor list, flashlight list, sensor tables, touch registration, NFC registration and fingerprint registration against the final Meizu component list.

script_plan.name: dts_i2c_address_validator
script_plan.purpose: Check final DTS for expected I2C buses and addresses, duplicate conflicts, missing interrupts, missing regulators and missing pinctrl states.

script_plan.name: defconfig_delta_validator
script_plan.purpose: Compare final defconfig against donor Huawei defconfig and ensure donor panels/cameras/sensors are removed or disabled unless explicitly verified.

script_plan.name: partial_driver_gate
script_plan.purpose: Block final build promotion while ili9881p_hd_dsi_txd, ltr578, ov8856jslmipiraw or AW3643 are still reference-only.

script_plan.name: boot_probe_log_validator
script_plan.purpose: After build and flash testing, parse boot logs for panel ID, I2C probe success, sensor registration, camera probe, charger detection, NFC init, fingerprint init, Wi-Fi init and audio card registration.

summary.assessment: The local tree has usable MT6755-generation support for many peripherals, but it is a Huawei 6750/6755 donor configuration and must not be shipped with donor panel/camera/sensor assumptions. Four stock-named devices remain partial or unverified: ili9881p_hd_dsi_txd, ltr578, ov8856jslmipiraw, and leds-AW3643. TPS65132 is only evidenced through LCM-side references, not a standalone verified power driver. Wi-Fi and audio are not described in the supplied hardware profile and require separate audit.
summary.evidence_policy: Treat DeviceInfoHW and stock profile names as evidence only. Final binding must be validated against stock DTB, LK/display logs, boot logs, pinctrl, regulator, and board files.
